paper_metadata.title: Enhanced mechanical properties of a near-α titanium alloy by tailoring the silicide precipitation behavior through severe plastic deformation

evidence.quote: The microstructure evolution, tensile properties, and strengthening mechanisms of a near-α high-temperature titanium alloy with high Zr and Si content during isothermal multi-dimensional forging (IMDF) at the β-phase region were systematically investigated.

parameters.deformation: successive pressing along A, B, and C directions, each with 50% reduction; shape and size unchanged before and after deformation

evidence.quote: After solutioning, three 35 mm × 35 mm × 70 mm blocks were cut from the alloy, painted with coatings, and ready for the following IMDF procedure. The detailed IMDF process is shown in Fig. 1a. In the constant temperature environment, the specimens were successively pressed down along A, B, and C directions, each time with 50% of the pressed-down amount, and the shape and size were unchanged before and after deformation. Prior to each deformation step, the samples were insulated at the corresponding temperature for 20 min.
